=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:513-525 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Standalone placeholder detection does not mirror render_prompt_text's whitespace tolerance
  WHY: STANDALONE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN (used by render_prompt_text) accepts lines with leading/trailing whitespace, but collect_standalone_placeholders only matches exact lines via fullmatch after splitlines(). This can cause reference resolution to miss placeholders that the renderer would substitute, leading to inconsistent behavior.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:232 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Unnecessary sort on already sorted tuple
  WHY: collect_standalone_placeholders returns a sorted tuple, but collect_reference_values applies sorted() again to reference_placeholders, performing redundant work with no behavioral change.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:520-525 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Inefficient pure Python line iteration for large prompt bodies
  WHY: For very large editor prompt bodies (e.g., reviewer consensus files with long inlined PR diffs), splitting the entire string and iterating line-by-line in Python is slower and more memory-intensive than a compiled multiline regex with re.MULTILINE.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:520-525 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new helper does not match the whitespace-tolerant contract implemented by render_prompt_text / STANDALONE_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN (which accepts leading/trailing whitespace via `^[ \t]*...[ \t]*$`). fullmatch(line) after splitlines() (which strips trailing whitespace) will reject a placeholder line that has only leading whitespace or certain trailing variants that the renderer would treat as standalone.
  WHY: Inconsistent placeholder resolution between reference collection (collect_reference_values) and actual block substitution in render_prompt_text when prompts contain "    {{REFERENCE_FOO}}" style lines. The regression test only exercises the no-whitespace case.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:517-525 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: For large editor prompt bodies (common in review_autofix — inlined reviewer consensus, PR diff, logs, etc.) the function does full splitlines() + Python loop + fullmatch on every line.
  WHY: Unnecessary linear Python work on multi-megabyte strings; reviewer consensus already flagged this (lines 520-525). The Gemini comment in PR comments provides a single compiled re.MULTILINE alternative that runs entirely in C.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:231 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: After switching from collect_placeholders(...) (which was unsorted inside the generator) to collect_standalone_placeholders(...) (which already returns a sorted tuple), the outer sorted(...) is now a no-op.
  WHY: Purely redundant work; no behavioral change but the diff introduced unnecessary code. The consensus finding (confidence 2) is valid.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
